standard_prerequisites.name: The Kolmogorov, quasi-sober and sober separation properties, and the notion of a locally closed subspace
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's sections on irreducible components and sober spaces, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the three properties the statement transfers to a subspace and the hypothesis under which the transfer is claimed.

core_obligations: Part (1): for distinct points of the subspace the proof compares the closures in X intersected with Y, using that the closure of a singleton in the subspace is the intersection of its closure in X with Y, and concludes that the two intersections differ, which is the Kolmogorov condition for Y (proof lines 1224-1228).

Part (2): for locally closed Y the proof writes Y as the intersection of an open and a closed subset and, given an irreducible closed subset of Y, takes its closure in X and uses that its generic point, being in Y, provides a generic point in Y; this is where quasi-sobriety of X is used (proof lines 1229-1243).
Part (3): sobriety of Y follows immediately from (1) and (2), since a sober space is quasi-sober and Kolmogorov (proof lines 1244-1245).
Conclusion: the three numbered assertions of the statement (proof line 1245).
proof_roadmap: (1) 用子空间中单点的闭包等于 X 中闭包与 Y 的交，比较两个交集得到 Kolmogorov 性。
(2) 把局部闭子集写成开集与闭集之交，取不可约闭子集在 X 中的闭包，其 generic point 落在 Y 中，即为 Y 的 generic point；再用 X 的 quasi-sober 性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the inheritance of the separation properties by locally closed subspaces (author lemma at source lines 1212-1221, label lemma-sober-subspace): Kolmogorov passes to any subspace, quasi-sober and sober pass to locally closed subspaces. The proof (source lines 1223-1246) has real content in part (2): writing the locally closed subspace as the intersection of an open and a closed subset, the author takes the closure in the ambient space of an irreducible closed subset of the subspace and argues that its generic point lies in the subspace and therefore serves as a generic point there, which is exactly where quasi-sobriety of the ambient space is consumed (proof lines 1229-1243). Part (1) is a short closure computation and part (3) is the immediate combination, as the author says. H2.
